I'm able to get lavaan to estimate the model without issues, but I'm not sure what needs to change for blavaan to run successfully.

I have attached my code, the complete error code and my data.

Thanks in advance.

Best,

DeAnne

DeAnne, instead of specifying your priors as a list(), use the dpriors() command (just replace "list" with "dpriors"). I am guessing this will fix the problem. Please reply again if not!

Ed

messages.subject: blavaan 0.5-4
messages.body_plain:
blavaan 0.5-4 is now on CRAN, including bug fixes and a sampleData() convenience function for generating data from the posterior (or prior) distribution.

The website also includes some new slides from my NCME workshop on Bayesian modeling last week, which illustrate much of the newer functionality in blavaan. An aim was to present and illustrate SEM as a model of raw data, as opposed to solely a model of covariance matrices. See the first bullet of this page:

https://ecmerkle.github.io/blavaan/articles/resources.html

Ed

messages.subject: Parameter labels and translation to Stan syntax
messages.subject_clean: Parameter labels and translation to Stan syntax
messages.body_plain:
Hi Ed & others,

Thanks for this great piece of software.

I'm having some trouble with lavaan-style parameter labels for multigroup equality constraints when using target="stan".  I suspect there might be some issue in the translation from lavaan syntax to Stan syntax? Here is one example, for a multigroup longitudinal CFA model:

my_model <- "
            F1 =~ c(a,b)*x1 + y1 + c(e,f)*z1
            F2 =~ c(a,b)*x2 + y2 + c(e,f)*z2
            x1 ~~ x2
            y1 ~~ y2
            z1 ~~ z2"

fit <- bcfa(model = my_model,
            data = df,
            n.chains = 2,
            sample = 25000,
            burnin = 25000,
            std.lv <http://std.lv> = TRUE,
            group = "education_group",
            target="stan")

Here is the error message:

[1] "Error in if (lamsign[l2, 1] == 1) l2 <- lamsign[l2, 2] : \n  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed\n"
attr(,"class")
[1] "try-error"
attr(,"condition")
<simpleError in if (lamsign[l2, 1] == 1) l2 <- lamsign[l2, 2]: missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed>
Error in blavaan(model = "\n            WM1 =~ c(a,b)*nbsc1 + susc1 + c(e,f)*llsc1\n            WM2 =~ c(a,b)*nbsc2 + susc2 + c(e,f)*llsc2\n            nbsc1 ~~ nbsc2\n            susc1 ~~ susc2\n            llsc1 ~~ llsc2",  :
  blavaan ERROR: problem with translation from lavaan to MCMC syntax.

---

I'm able to estimate the model using target="jags", but would prefer Stan if possible. I've toyed around with different ways of rewriting the model syntax, but so far to no avail. Is there a workaround? Or is there maybe some issue with my input?

Thanks a lot.

/Amos
